result.summary: Reviewed git diff main...HEAD -- web/tests/e2e/ directly. helpers.ts's new getMasterAdminToken mirrors the existing getKeycloakToken shape exactly: same APIRequestContext param, resolveCredential(KC_ADMIN_USER/KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD, 'admin') for creds, throw-with-response-text on !ok(), typed JSON body -- a clean fit with the established pattern, not a divergent shape. Scope check: full diff (excluding handoff/design artifacts) touches exactly helpers.ts (new helper) + the 5 named call sites (env04.e2e.spec.ts x2, and one each in attachment-cross-tenant/shipment-attach-delivery-note/tenant-cache pipeline specs), removing the 2 duplicated local getMasterAdminToken helpers in the pipeline specs -- no other files, no unrelated refactors. env04.e2e.spec.ts site #1 (onboardTestTenantFixture): confirmed the try/catch is genuine behavior preservation -- old code checked !resp.ok() and did console.warn + return undefined; new code wraps only the getMasterAdminToken call in try/catch with the same '[ENV-04C]' warn prefix and same return undefined, and does not extend to wrap any of the subsequent password-reset logic, so it cannot mask a later, different failure. Site #2 (cleanupOnboardedTestTenantFixture) and the tenant-cache spec's cleanup both let the throw propagate into their existing outer best-effort try/catch (equivalent to the prior if(ok()) no-op shape). No crutch, no inconsistency, no scope creep found.
